title: Duetkifu research record (kifu.json)
description: The research record next to report.json: every move of a research (each attempt, correction, audit, conclusion and planned option), the move it follows, why it was made, what came of it and, for a dead end, why it ended. The report tells a few lines of it; the record keeps all of them. Paths are relative to the folder of kifu.json. `python duetkifu.py kifu check FOLDER` checks the rules that a schema cannot express (parents, links, evidence steps, required reasons).

question.description: What the research asks, in one sentence.

metric.description: How moves are compared, so that results stay comparable within one record.

groups.description: The name shown for each group label of the moves, for example {"D": "Is the prediction accurate"}.

changes.description: The change log of the record, one document per changed field, as in report.json. The page writes one for every edit; add, delete and the field names of a move are the fields.

field.description: A field of the move such as status or result.text, or add / delete.

id.description: Same as the key in moves.

no.description: The order in which the moves were made (the timeline for replaying the research).

parent.description: The move whose result and ideas this one follows; null for the research question. One parent only: other relations go in links.

title.description: One sentence: what this move does.

group.description: A free label for a branch of the research, for example A or G.

why.description: Why this move: the hypothesis, what it rests on, the options considered.

status.description: planned: thought of but not done (a variation not played), which is kept on purpose.

cause.description: Why a move failed, was inconclusive or was paused. idea (the hypothesis was wrong) and measurement (the data cannot be trusted, so the path was not really tested) are different dead ends.

causeConfirmed.description: false while the cause is only an agent's suggestion.

reason.description: The cause in plain words. Required for failure, inconclusive and paused.

population.description: Which samples, window and filters the numbers of this move refer to.

conditions.description: Conditions and parameters (recipe, temperature, instrument, sample batch...).

trigger.description: Who or what started this move.

when.description: The date as the sources give it, for example 8/24 or late August.

at.description: ISO date, only when it is known.

file.description: A report or slide file, relative to the folder of kifu.json.

addedFrom.description: Where a move added after the fact comes from.

mark.description: A review mark added afterwards, as in reviewing a game.

kind.description: turning-point, root-cause, champion, breakthrough or pivot; other values are shown as they are, with a warning from check.

links.description: Relations besides the parent. A correction is stored only on the correcting move (type corrects).

dataOutside.description: true when the raw data of this move is outside the opened folder, so it cannot join the data chain.

pos.description: Where the user dragged this move on the tree diagram (SVG units). Only the tree layout reads it; time and list layouts ignore it.

steps.description: Ids of steps in report.json that recomputed this move's numbers (data chain level: recomputed).

files.description: The files this move's numbers come from, with their fingerprints, when they were not recomputed (data chain level: sourced): the report, table, figure or script. check flags a file that changed or is missing.

path.description: Relative to the folder of kifu.json.

note.description: Where in the file, for example a section or a slide.

noData.description: Why this move has no data (data chain level: none), for example a literature note or an experiment not run yet.

checks.description: A number the record states, against the same number recomputed from the raw files. A mismatch is listed for the user to decide; nothing is rewritten automatically.

match.description: yes: within tolerance; close: same direction and size, other samples or window; no: different; not-reproducible: the definition or the data is lost.

decidedBy.description: Set when a person, not a recomputation, decided the match (for example user).
